purpose: diagnostic of rollout sampling, not promotion or an algorithm ranking
reward: unchanged reward v2; no living-mass bonus
legacy_sampler: four independent 256-row subsets, allowing overlap between subsets
epoch_sampler: one permutation of every eligible hero row, balanced into ceil(n/256) batches
equalized_budget: hero transitions, not optimizer draws or wall time
evaluation_models: all ten final checkpoints, one paired initial checkpoint per training seed, plus greedy_food and random_safe references
primary_estimand: mean across five training seeds of each seed's mean over twelve paired world-seed deltas: final epoch mass integral minus final legacy mass integral
primary_interval: two-sided 95% Student-t interval with training seed as independent unit (n=5, df=4)
diagnostic_success: primary confidence interval lower bound greater than zero; separate numerical health and coverage correctness
failure_handling: record every assigned arm; stop campaign on runtime/resource failure; incomplete pairs cannot support primary success
known_limits: five training seeds remain a small screen
all heroes co-learn despite frozen pool disabled
existing safety-mask targets and flip geometry remain unchanged confounds
MPS short replay matched hashes but full-run deterministic reproducibility is not assumed
The same initial/rollout RNG seeds do not imply identical future world trajectories once learned actions diverge.
amendment_reason: Revision 2 control hit one-update action entropy alarm at332548 transitions with only64 real rows. This metric was post-sampling/post-augmentation and could censor sampler arms differently. Both arms now guard on raw unique eligible rollout actions, requiring same-action unanimity over at least3 consecutive updates and2048 real rows; changes of dominant action reset the window. Numerical and resource guards unchanged. All ten arms restart before any heldout evaluation outcomes are inspected.
sgd_rng_seed: training_seed + 10000000, separate from rollout exploration RNG in both arms
action_collapse_interpretation: Emergency heuristic for sustained repeated same-action rollout unanimity, not statistical proof of global policy collapse; rows within trajectories are correlated.
